initial_config.name: quick
initial_config.model: u=h*z+e; z~CN(0,q), e~CN(0,sI); latent z and h unavailable to estimator
initial_config.prior: Uniform on all native complex lines; not restricted to the ULA angle curve
initial_config.validation: Independent trajectories; expected true output power selects each family/horizon. Mean, same-A mode and matched isotropization share the selected mean memory. EW PCA, scalar regularization, loaded covariance and GROUSE are selected separately.
initial_config.stationary: beta=1 fixed for Haar and stationary ULA; uniform ambient complex-line prior
initial_config.moving: Identity transport; each family selects memory from validation, not the true angle path.
initial_config.scalar: rho*P+(1-rho)I/n, optimized continuously on independent validation, separately from per-posterior matched isotropization
initial_config.statistics: Strict trajectory-level paired Student intervals; all snapshots, queries and posterior draws within a trajectory are not independent replications.
initial_config.tail_scope: Exact iid native-complex samples; sample quantiles and independent mass/CDF checks are Monte Carlo approximations, not deterministic tail certificates.
initial_config.primary: Complete SNR/snapshot decision map; comparisons are pointwise exploratory, without choosing a winning test regime.
